```{r}
#| include: false
library(glmmTMB)

library(multcomp)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)
library(car)

library(MuMIn)

library(emmeans)

set.seed(42)
```

# Data 

```{r, echo=F}
data <- read.table("data.tsv", header=T)
```


```{r}
#| include: false
str(data)
sum(is.na(data$presence))
with(data, table(method, is.na(presence)))

data <- data |>
  mutate(across(c(location, season, filter, method, barrelId), factor),
         volume   = as.numeric( trimws(volume, whitespace = "[ \\h\\v]") ), # trim unicode ws too
         presence = as.integer(presence))

snail <- data |>
  filter(method == "snail") |>
  group_by(barrelId) |>
  summarise(snail = as.integer(any(presence == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
            consistent = n_distinct(na.omit(presence)) <= 1, .groups = "drop")

all(snail$consistent)
```


```{r}
edna <- data |>
  filter(method != "snail", !is.na(presence)) |>
  rename("molecular_method" = "method") |>
  droplevels() |>
  left_join(snail, by = "barrelId") |>
  mutate(sampleId = interaction(barrelId, filter, replication, drop = TRUE),
         turb_z   = as.numeric(scale(log(turbidity))),
         molecular_method = relevel(molecular_method, "qPCR"))
```

```{r}
# presence: did the molecular method detect the presence of parasites?
# snail: was the presence of parasites detected in snails?
# match: presence in molecular methods == presence based on snails?
ev2 <- 
  edna |>
  mutate(
    method = interaction(filter, molecular_method, sep = "_", drop = TRUE),
    match = as.numeric(snail == presence)
    ) |>
  mutate(
    method = as.character(method),
    filter = as.character(filter),
    molecular_method = as.character(molecular_method)
    )
```


```{r}

#filter effect (all 3 filters + (qPCR + LAMP) )
edna_nRAA <- droplevels(subset(edna, molecular_method != "RAA"))
str(edna_nRAA)


#method effect (filter C only + all 3 methods)
edna_C <- droplevels(subset(edna, filter == "C"))
str(edna_C)

```


- fixed factors are:
  - *filter* = filter type (`A`, `B`, `C`)
  - *molecular_method* = analytical strategies (`qPCR`, `LAMP`, `RAA`)
  - *turb_z* = turbidity
  - *season* = seasons
- random factors are:
  - *location* = sampling locality
  - *barrelId* = location + date (= barrel ID)
  - *sampleId* = barrelId (location + date) + filter + replication (= filtered volume)
  

# Statistics

- Stat 1
  - Stat 1a
    - sensitivity (do they detect the presence of parasites?)
    - A, B, C filters
    - qPCR, LAMP
  - Stat 1b
    - sensitivity (do they detect the presence of parasites?)
    - C filter only
    - qPCR, LAMP, RAA
- Stat 2 ($\to$ Supplement)
  - sensitivity (do they detect the presence of parasites?)
  - aggregate categories (e.g., A_qPCR, C_RAA)
- Stat 3
  - concordance (do the observations agree with the parasite presence detected in snails?)
  - aggregate categories (e.g., A_qPCR, C_RAA)
- Stat 4
  - sensitivity (do they detect the presence of parasites?)
  - data filtered to cases when parasite presence is confirmed by observing snail cercarial shedding (could the molecular tests successfully detect parasite presence)
  - aggregate categories (e.g., A_qPCR, C_RAA)

# Stat 1 
## Stat 1 a: FILTER (*A*, *B*, *C*) + AMPLIF (*qPCR*, *LAMP*)
### Model selection 
```{r}

m_RAA_f0 <- glmmTMB(presence ~ filter + molecular_method + turb_z + season +
                      filter : molecular_method + 
                      filter : turb_z + 
                      (1 | location) + (1 | barrelId) + (1 | sampleId),
                    family = binomial, data = edna_nRAA)

summary(m_RAA_f0)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_RAA_f0, type=3)


options(na.action = "na.fail")
dd <- MuMIn::dredge(m_RAA_f0, rank=AIC, extra = alist(AICc, BIC, ICOMP, Cp))
options(na.action = "na.omit")
m1 <- MuMIn::get.models(dd, subset = 1)[[1]] 


```

### Best model
```{r}
summary(m1)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m1, type=3)
```


```{r}
m1.emm_f <- emmeans(m1,
                  ~ filter,
                  type = "response")


kable(
  multcomp::cld(m1.emm_f,
                    adjust="bonferroni",
                    Letters=LETTERS) ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```


```{r}
m1.emm_a <- emmeans(m1,
                  ~ molecular_method,
                  type = "response")

kable(
  multcomp::cld(m1.emm_a,
                    adjust="bonferroni",
                    Letters=LETTERS) ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```

```{r}
m1.emm <- emmeans(m1,
                  ~ filter | molecular_method,
                  type = "response")


kable(
  multcomp::cld(m1.emm,
                    adjust="bonferroni",
                    Letters=LETTERS) ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```

```{r}
m1.emm_m_f <- emmeans(m1,
                  ~ molecular_method | filter,
                  type = "response")


kable(
  multcomp::cld(m1.emm_m_f,
                    adjust="bonferroni",
                    Letters=LETTERS) ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```

#### Diagnistics 

```{r}
m1_Res1 <- simulateResiduals(m1)
plot(m1_Res1, quantreg = T)
testDispersion(m1_Res1)

```

#### Plot

```{r}
emmip(
  m1,
  molecular_method ~ filter,
  type = "response",
  CIs = TRUE
) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Filter",
    y = "Estimated detection probability",
    colour = "Molecular method",
    title = "Parasite detection by filter and amplification method",
    subtitle = "Points: model estimates; bars: 95% confidence intervals"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Stat 1 b: FILTER (*C*) + AMPLIF (*qPCR*, *LAMP*, *RAA*)  
### Model selection 
```{r}

m_C_f0 <- glmmTMB(presence ~  molecular_method + turb_z + season +
                     (1 | location) + (1 | barrelId) + (1 | sampleId),
                   family = binomial, data = edna_C)

summary(m_C_f0)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_C_f0, type=2)


options(na.action = "na.fail")
ddc <- MuMIn::dredge(m_C_f0, rank=AIC, extra = alist(AICc, BIC, ICOMP, Cp))
options(na.action = "na.omit")
m1c <- MuMIn::get.models(ddc, subset = 1)[[1]] 

```

### Best model
```{r}
summary(m1c)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m1c, type=2)

m1c.emm <- emmeans(m1c,
                  ~ molecular_method,
                  type = "response")


kable(
  multcomp::cld(m1c.emm,
                    adjust="bonferroni",
                    Letters=LETTERS) ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```


```{r}
m1c_Res1 <- simulateResiduals(m1c)
plot(m1c_Res1, quantreg = T)
testDispersion(m1c_Res1)
```

```{r}
plot_data <- as.data.frame(m1c.emm)

cld_data <- as.data.frame(
  multcomp::cld(
    m1c.emm,
    adjust = "bonferroni",
    Letters = LETTERS
  )
)

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  left_join(
    cld_data |> select(molecular_method, .group),
    by = "molecular_method"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    .group = trimws(.group),
    molecular_method = factor(
      molecular_method,
      levels = c("LAMP", "RAA", "qPCR")
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = prob, y = molecular_method)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, xmax = asymp.UCL),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = asymp.UCL + 0.025, label = .group),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1),
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of different molecular methods on detection sensitivity with filter C",
    x = "Estimated probability of detection",
    y = "Amplification method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## *p*-value correction

When applying two hypothesis testing on the same data, we have to apply *p*-value correction, in order to be allowed to draw conclusions. 

- The most strict correction is the Bonferroni correction.
- **Holm** or Holm-Bonferroni is less strict control, but still applicable.

```{r}

# log-odds scale
# use previous emmeans for the rest
filter_tests2 <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(
    emmeans(m1, 
            ~ filter | molecular_method
            # ~ filter 
            ),
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

method_tests2 <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(
    emmeans(m1c, ~ molecular_method),
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

bind_rows(
  filter_tests2 |> mutate(family = "Filter comparisons"),
  method_tests2 |> mutate(family = "Methods within C")
) |>
  mutate(
    p_holm = p.adjust(p.value, method = "holm"),
    p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
    lower= estimate - qnorm(0.975) * SE,
    upper= estimate + qnorm(0.975) * SE
  ) |>
  kable()

```


# Stat 2: Full combination model  --> Supplement

*fm* means the combination of filter types and amplification methods.

```{r}

edna$fm <- interaction(edna$filter, edna$molecular_method, drop = TRUE, sep = "_")

```

### Model selection 

```{r}

m_fm_f0 <- glmmTMB(presence ~  fm + turb_z + season +
                     (1 | location) + (1 | barrelId) + (1 | sampleId),
                   family = binomial, data = edna)


summary(m_fm_f0)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_fm_f0, type=2)


options(na.action = "na.fail")
ddfm <- MuMIn::dredge(m_fm_f0, rank=AIC)
options(na.action = "na.omit")
m1fm <- MuMIn::get.models(ddfm, subset = 1)[[1]] 

```

### Best model

```{r}
summary(m1fm)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m1fm, type=2)

m1fm.emm <- emmeans(m1fm,
                  ~ fm,
                  type = "response")


kable(
  multcomp::cld(m1fm.emm,
                    adjust="bonferroni",
                    Letters=LETTERS) ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```


```{r}
m1fm_Res1 <- simulateResiduals(m1fm)
plot(m1fm_Res1, quantreg = T)
testDispersion(m1fm_Res1)

```

```{r}
plot_data <- as.data.frame(m1fm.emm)

cld_data <- as.data.frame(
  multcomp::cld(
    m1fm.emm,
    adjust = "bonferroni",
    Letters = LETTERS
  )
)

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  left_join(
    cld_data |> select(fm, .group),
    by = "fm"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    .group = trimws(.group),
    fm = factor(fm, levels = rev(fm[order(prob)]))
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = prob, y = fm)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, xmax = asymp.UCL),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = asymp.UCL + 0.025, label = .group),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1),
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Estimated probability of detection",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 
```

# Stat 3: eDNA validity


## Snail concordance
Are observation the same in snails than with eDNA?

### Model selection 

```{r}

m_match2_full <- glmmTMB(match ~  method + turb_z + season +
                     (1 | location) + (1 | barrelId) + (1 | sampleId),
                   family = binomial, data = ev2 )


summary(m_match2_full)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_match2_full, type=2)

options(na.action = "na.fail")
d_match2 <- MuMIn::dredge(m_match2_full, rank=AIC, extra = alist(AICc, BIC, ICOMP, Cp))
options(na.action = "na.omit")
m_match2 <- MuMIn::get.models(d_match2, subset = 1)[[1]] 
```

### Best model

```{r}
summary(m_match2)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_match2, type=2)

m_match2.emm <- emmeans(m_match2,
                  ~ method,
                  type = "response")
```

```{r}
kable(
  multcomp::cld(m_match2.emm,
              adjust="bonferroni",
              Letters=LETTERS)) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```

```{r}
match2_Res1 <- simulateResiduals(m_match2)
plot(match2_Res1, quantreg = T)
# testDispersion(match2_Res1)
testResiduals(match2_Res1)
# testUniformity(match2_Res1)
# testCategorical(match2_Res1, catPred =~method)
# testCategorical(match2_Res1, ~location)
# testCategorical(match2_Res1, catPred =~location)
# testCategorical(match2_Res1, ~barrelId)
# testCategorical(match2_Res1, ~sampleId)
# testOutliers(match2_Res1, type = "binomial")


```

```{r}
# simulate 
sim <- simulateResiduals(m_match2, n = 1000, seed = 123)
plot(sim)
```

```{r}
plot_data <- as.data.frame(m_match2.emm)

cld_data <- as.data.frame(
  multcomp::cld(
    m_match2.emm,
    adjust = "bonferroni",
    Letters = LETTERS
  )
)

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  left_join(
    cld_data |> select(method, .group),
    by = "method"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    .group = trimws(.group),
    method = factor(method)
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = prob, y = method)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, xmax = asymp.UCL),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = asymp.UCL + 0.025, label = .group),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Effect of different molecular methods"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Confirmed pozitive cases (snail + is + / - in eDNA?)

```{r}
edna2 <-  edna |> filter(snail==T)

edna2 |> select(presence, fm) |> table()
```

### Model selection
```{r}
m_fp_f0 <-  glmmTMB(presence ~  fm + turb_z + season +
                      (1 | location) + (1 | barrelId) + (1 | sampleId),
                    family = binomial, data = edna2 )


summary(m_fp_f0)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_fp_f0, type=2)

options(na.action = "na.fail")
d_pres <- MuMIn::dredge(m_fp_f0, rank=AIC, extra = alist(AICc, BIC, ICOMP, Cp))
options(na.action = "na.omit")
m_pres <- MuMIn::get.models(d_pres, subset = 1)[[1]] 
m_pres2 <- MuMIn::get.models(d_pres, subset = 2)[[1]]
anova(m_pres, m_pres2)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_pres, type=2)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_pres2, type=2)
```

### Best model
```{r}
summary(m_pres2)
glmmTMB:::Anova.glmmTMB(m_pres2, type=2)

m_pres2.emm <- emmeans(m_pres2,
                  pairwise ~ fm,
                  type = "response")
```


```{r}
kable(
  multcomp::cld(emmeans(m_pres2, ~ fm,
                  type = "response"),
              adjust="bonferroni",
              Letters=LETTERS)) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position")
```


```{r}
pres2_Res1 <- simulateResiduals(m_pres2)
plot(pres2_Res1, quantreg = T)
#testDispersion(pres2_Res1)
testResiduals(pres2_Res1)
#testUniformity(pres2_Res1)

```

Get CI for turbidity

```{r}
beta <- fixef(m_pres2)$cond["turb_z"]
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m_pres2)$cond))["turb_z"]
beta + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * se
```
